title: Suno Prompt Guide: Write Better Prompts with A/B Tests
reported_observation: The guide suggests a one-variable A/B protocol: preserve lyrics, model and settings, generate equal samples, blind-listen where practical and score only the target audible trait.
creator_interpretation: Useful general experimental discipline, but its conventional prompt anatomy should not define the future Prompt Workbench.
our_hypothesis: The same protocol can test more unusual concepts, including local triggers, state persistence, semantic/phonetic interactions and malformed prompt structure.
limitations: Research capture summary, not a full audit of the source.
